div.div:
Notes
*1 Four client tools
AWS CLI, s5cmd, rclone, and Mountpoint for Amazon S3. Checked on real hardware from an EC2 instance in ap-northeast-1 on 2026-11-24 (one configuration, one run each).
*2 The copy measured on real hardware ran only from bucket to volume
With AWS CLI, s5cmd, and rclone. The other direction is in a Playbook record. The documents say one Region only. Owner, mode, and modification time were not carried over (a Playbook measurement, root user configuration only).
*3 The AWS services in the frame are expectations from documents
Not checked on real hardware in this repository.
*4 Where the NFS / SMB clients run is not specified
The figure does not show VPC or on premises.
